headline: Google links Wallet and Drive to Search personalization
dek: According to Google and TechCrunch, AI Mode will use spending and documents in its answers.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: What Google announced
body: Google began connecting Wallet, Drive and the Gemini app to AI Mode's Personal Intelligence in Search (Google AI, TechCrunch AI).
Before, the feature already used Gmail, Calendar and Google Photos, the company says (Google AI).

s3.label: How it works
s3.title: What each app does
s3.body: According to Google, the feature is optional and each app is turned on by hand.

points.t: Uses spending history; the AI only reads, it can't move money (Google AI).
Checks documents and sheets for specific answers (TechCrunch AI).
A search can continue between the app and Search (Google AI).

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: User control
body: The connection can be turned off whenever the user wants (Google AI).
A Personalization icon will show what context was used, no date given (Google AI).

stat.cap: each app is enabled by the user (Google AI)

items.t: Began rolling out on Monday (Google AI).
Arrives in the coming weeks, Google says (Google AI).
TechCrunch AI notes Google holds data rivals lack.

caption.hook: Google links Wallet and Drive to Search personalization.
body: According to Google and TechCrunch, AI Mode's Personal Intelligence in Search now connects to Wallet, Drive and the Gemini app, on top of Gmail, Calendar and Photos (Google AI, TechCrunch AI). With Wallet, the AI uses spending history but only reads the account and cannot move money.

The feature is opt-in: each app is turned on manually and can be switched off whenever the user wants (Google AI). Wallet began rolling out Monday, and Drive and Gemini arrive in the coming weeks. TechCrunch AI notes Google holds personal data that search rivals lack.
caption.cta: Would you let a search engine read your Drive and spending history?
